career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography says she became a structural engineer after graduating in 1988 and moved to Sydney in 1992. Employer, exact dates, sector, hours, leave and continuity are unresolved; the endpoints are contextual bounds rather than a complete employment interval. ABC 2026 interview corroborates engineering employment in Pakistan but does not name the organisation. Oral history27:16–30:18 describes the employer as a large engineering consulting firm in Pakistan, with roughly2,000 men and where she met her future husband. The firm is not named; consulting does not itself establish private ownership.

career_spells.role: Master of Engineering Science and PhD student
career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography records arrival and UNSW study from 1992, completion of the master's degree in 1994 and environmental-engineering doctorate in 2000; UNSW alumni material corroborates the qualifications. Exact enrolment dates, load and research-employment overlap are unresolved. Current UNSW alumni profile independently confirms MEngSc 1994 and PhD 2000. Oral history33:20–36:27 distinguishes an initially offered non-resident scholarship declined in favour of permanent residency from the later scholarship-linked CRC work at39:54. She says she initially chose study rather than seeking a full-time job; this does not establish the hours of every subsequent research role.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies the employer, role and month-level boundaries. Exact days, hours, leave and overlap with doctoral study are unresolved. The 11April2014 oral history at40:14–42:18 explicitly links Sinclair Knight Merz to work before the family moved out of Sydney and says both partners were working full time. This supports a full-time role at that stage, not verified full-time continuity throughout. It recalls a1998 start and about three years there, conflicting with official March1999–June2001 dates, which are retained pending reconciliation. Transcript is community-corrected; audio and personal contract not independently checked.
career_spells.counting_note: Full-time work is now explicitly employer-linked, but its exact interval, leave and conflicting start dates remain unresolved. No point total calculated from month labels or recollected duration.

research_notes: The frozen official record provides unusually strong month-level continuity for Australian employment from January 1993 to June 2013, except May–December 2008 and July 2001.
The pre-Australia structural-engineering employer remains unidentified and is not coded public or private.
University roles are retained as paid employment but excluded from the narrow headline under the current codebook.
No management or academic title is treated as proof of substantive full-time status.

Follow-up 2026-10-01: ABR and scanned NSW interests returns identify previously omitted self-employment. The business may overlap salaried roles and elected office; no sequential or additive duration is assumed.

Explicit full-time evidence exists but is not yet sufficiently allocated: AAP interview describes work during an unidentified state-election campaign; ABC 2026 describes full-time work before the Port Macquarie move. Neither justifies assigning full-time status throughout a named spell. These leads replace a blanket assumption that no full-time testimony exists.

Search avenues: UNSW alumni and archived course material; primary interests returns; ABR; first-person AAP/ABC interviews; Pakistani engineering-employer searches. No corroborated Pakistan employer or leave/hours interval found. March 2011 South Sydney Herald search hit for a small consulting business belongs to James Falk, not Faruqi, and is rejected.

Follow-up leads: locate clients/invoices or contemporary consulting biographies for operational dates; resolve campaign year/employer in full-time testimony; obtain UNSW/council appointment and leave records; corroborate SBS 2018 reference to Macquarie University before adding a role. A later course-author credit alone does not prove later paid employment.

Individual source gaps: NSW inaugural PDF returned 404; Queensland tabled interests copy later returned 403; historical ABR view failed. Current ABR and accessible NSW return copy supplied usable alternatives. These are source gaps, not job-wide limits.

Second follow-up2October2026 recovered the publicly downloadable State Library oral-history transcript after the web reader returned only the application shell. This materially resolves the employer link of the pre-Port Macquarie full-time account and adds scholarship-linked CRC work, cooperative childcare and Pakistan NGO visits. No arbitrary dates or full-spell hours inferred.

AAP2022 and ABC2026 accounts re-read: campaign year remains unspecified; ABC alone still does not name the full-time employer. The2014 oral history provides the missing SKM link. Public LinkedIn index suggests July2004 IES start versus official August2004, but the full entry was not available for reliable reconciliation; official boundary retained. SBS2018 Macquarie University reference remains uncorroborated by an employer record.

Next priority: verify oral-history audio around39:54–42:18 and original SKM appointment/leave documentation to reconcile1998 versus March1999; identify the large Pakistan consulting firm without guessing from size; identify CRC contract entity and NGO organisations.
open_questions: Who employed Faruqi as a structural engineer in Pakistan, on what dates and hours, and under what ownership?
What were the hours, leave and exact days for each UNSW, Sinclair Knight Merz and council appointment?
How did postgraduate study overlap the UNSW research and Sinclair Knight Merz roles?
What activity occurred from May through December 2008 and during the July 2001 transition?
Did the final UNSW appointment overlap NSW parliamentary service in June 2013, and what leave/cessation arrangements applied?
Were any Greens roles or campaigns paid, and how did they overlap employment?
When did Mehreen Faruqi Consulting actually trade, with what hours, clients and leave/overlaps? Registration from 2005 to 2023 is not proof of continuous work.
Which employer and exact period did each explicit full-time-work account describe? Was the campaign account 2011 or 2012, and did it include leave?

Reconcile oral-history1998 SKM start and approximately three-year duration with official March1999–June2001; establish the full-time interval and leave. Identify CRC payroll/contract arrangements and Pakistan NGO work dates/status.
